criteria.criterion: Wave 1 produces real, evidence-backed discovery findings (not assumptions) about which candidate improvement areas are genuine current gaps versus already solved.
criteria.evidence: Inspected docs/tsf/easyworkout-wave-1-discovery.md and independently compared the working-tree diff with canonical HEAD e48b7a570f8d15414f302ba76c6782e69ec55fef (also origin/main). git diff showed the two pre-change gaps exactly: the logger had a 'Fill first set' action and no exercise-input datalist; source inspection also confirmed existing history filters/review links, routines, statistics, draft retry/idempotency, loading/error states, and dashboard navigation documented as already solved. An isolated Chrome 152 run of the real built demo route at 390x844 confirmed the actual logger/dashboard behavior rather than relying on the Orca-only dogfood bridge.

criteria.criterion: At most 1-2 highest-impact, evidence-backed improvements are actually implemented -- not every candidate area blindly built.
criteria.evidence: git status --short and git diff --name-only showed implementation changes limited to CHANGELOG.md, EasyWorkoutLogPage.tsx, new workoutLogAssist.ts, and its focused test. The diff implements exactly two related user-facing improvements: all-set previous-performance prefill and recent/saved/built-in exercise-name lookup; rest timer, completed-session edit/delete, favorites, and redesign remain unimplemented/deferred.

criteria.criterion: The existing, already-proven-working core logging flow has zero regressions after any change -- verified by real use, not assumed.
criteria.evidence: Independent real-use smoke test on the built app in isolated Chrome 152: opened /app/easyworkout/log?routineId=demo-routine-upper&workoutMode=1&demo=1 at 390x844, observed Bench Press sets 185x5, 185x5, 185x4, edited the first weight to 190, used Fill all sets to restore 185/185/185, copied the previous set (3 to 4 sets), clicked Save workout, and reached /app/easyworkout/session/demo-saved-...?demo=1. The review rendered Upper — steady progress, Bench Press, 13 working sets, and Workout progress with zero captured console errors; npm.cmd test also passed 75/75 and npm.cmd run typecheck passed.

criteria.criterion: Any change to Firestore persistence, offline/retry, or auth-adjacent code is independently verified before being considered done, given this project's real prior incident (unauthorized wave10 production revert, 2026-08-13).
criteria.evidence: git diff --name-only inspection found no changed Firestore, Firebase, auth, persistence, or offline/retry file; the candidate is confined to logger presentation/domain assist plus tests and changelog. As a defense-in-depth regression check, npm.cmd test independently passed all 75 tests, including owner-isolated draft recovery, Firestore collision-safe idempotency, matching-draft clearing, rapid-save/two-tab retry coordination, failed-save retryability, Firebase configuration boundaries, and demo-route Firebase isolation. The production build also passed and no deploy, publish, credentials, emulator, or production write was performed.

criteria.criterion: An independent verifier reviews the final candidate before READY_FOR_ADOPTION.
criteria.evidence: This autonomous verification dispatch task_5891c2d4ec5d independently reviewed the final working-tree diff and helper/test source, ran git diff --check (clean), npm.cmd test (75 passed, 0 failed), npm.cmd run typecheck (exit 0), and npm.cmd run build (Vite 5.4.21, 211 modules transformed, successful). It additionally completed the isolated end-to-end demo save/review smoke test before producing this verdict; no READY_FOR_ADOPTION marker was present in the repository.

criteria.criterion: A subjective major-redesign recommendation, if any, is recorded as a recommendation only -- not built without further owner approval.
criteria.evidence: docs/tsf/easyworkout-wave-1-discovery.md explicitly states that subjective redesign remains recommendation-only and closes with 'No major redesign is recommended from this pass.' git diff confirms no layout redesign: the only UI edits add the datalist, change Fill first set to Fill all sets, and wire deterministic prefill/metadata helpers; the mobile smoke test also showed innerWidth 390 and document scrollWidth 390.
